children.name: Falling Arsenal
children.description: Once per combat, as a Riverview action, you can drop an ethereal copy of your main hand weapon in a space within 60 feet of you. The weapon remains there for 1 round, during which time its space and all spaces adjacent to it are a persistent zone, causing harm to foes of the weapon's base type equal to your level.

children.name: Retrieve Weapon
children.description: Once per combat, as a Riverview action, you can teleport to your Falling Arsenal's ethereal weapon, removing it and immediately causing harm to foes adjacent to you of the weapon's base type equal to your level.

children.name: Remote Retrieval
children.description: When you use your Retrieve Weapon, you can instead teleport to any space within 60 feet of you, but Retrieve Weapon's harm affects foes between you and the ethereal weapon instead of those adjacent to you.

children.name: Lethal Retrieval
children.description: Your Retrieve Weapon's harm increases by an amount equal to your level.

children.name: Weapon Eruption
children.description: Instead of removing the ethereal weapon when you use Retrieve Weapon, you extend its duration by 1 round.

children.name: Skull Cracker
children.description: When you use your Falling Arsenal, you attach the Sigil of the Arsenal to you and any minions adjacent to you for 1 round. Creatures with your Sigil of the Arsenal radiate a 5' persistent zone that causes harm to foes of the weapon's base type equal to your level.

children.name: Refreshing Sigil
children.description: 1/combat, when your Sigil of the Arsenal causes harm, you refresh the cooldown of your Falling Arsenal.

children.name: Lethal Sigil
children.description: Harm caused by your Sigil of the Arsenal is increased by an amount equal to your level.

children.name: Shared Sigil
children.description: The attachment range of your Skull Cracker increases to 30 feet.

children.name: Strength Ascendant
children.description: Whenever you use a Riverview action on Falling Arsenal or any of its descendant nodes, you deal additional damage for 1 round equal to your proficiency bonus.

children.name: Cruelty Ascendant
children.description: The damage bonus from your Strength Ascendant also applies to your outgoing harm.

children.name: Potent Strength
children.description: The damage bonus from your Strength Ascendant increases by an amount equal to your proficiency bonus.

children.name: Xiloan Overexertion
children.description: While you have the damage bonus from your Strength Ascendant, you may increase any rolled damage dice to their maximum value. Whenever you do so, you suffer psychic harm equal to half the total amount they were increased by.

children.name: Combat Skill
children.description: Whenever you long jump, you may cause harm of your main hand weapon's base type to one creature adjacent to your destination equal to your level.

children.name: Heavy Leap
children.description: After causing Combat Skill's harm, all foes adjacent to you are pushed 10' away from you.

children.name: Vacuum Leap
children.description: Heavy Leap instead pushes all foes within a number of feet equal to its push distance towards you, ignoring collision damage.

children.name: Massive Blast
children.description: Your Heavy Leap's push distance is increased to 20'.

children.name: Gravity Well
children.description: For 1 round after pushing creatures with your Heavy Leap, a persistent zone with radius equal to its push distance radiates from you. It restrains foes.

children.name: Momentum
children.description: The harm caused by your Combat Skill is increased by an amount equal to half the length (in feet) of the triggering long jump.

children.name: Athletic Ability
children.description: Your long jump distance is increased by 10'.

children.name: Pure Momentum
children.description: Momentum's bonus harm is now equal to the length of the triggering long jump, not half.

children.name: Slipstream
children.description: Each foe adjacent to the path of your long jumps suffers force harm equal to your proficiency bonus.

children.name: Kinetic Echo
children.description: Whenever you long jump, an ethereal after-image of you lingers at your starting point until the end of the next round, when it violently snaps towards the jump's destination, causing force harm to all foes along the path equal to your level plus your proficiency bonus.

children.name: Echo Ricochet
children.description: Whenever your Kinetic Echo snaps forward, choose a second point within 30 feet of its original destination for it to then snap to, causing force harm to foes along that path as well equal to your level.

children.name: Temporal Distortion
children.description: Your Kinetic Echo snaps forward an additional time 1 round after it originally did (this doesn't affect the first snap forward), with the same effects as the first snap forward.

children.name: Echo Implosion
children.description: Whenever your Kinetic Echo snaps forward toward a new point, it leaves behind a 15'x15' persistent zone centred on its origin point for 1 round. The zone causes force harm equal to your level plus your proficiency bonus.

children.name: Ferocious Knight
children.description: Whenever you score a major success with a melee attack, the target becomes frightened of you for 1 round.

children.name: Ferocious Barrage
children.description: Whenever you score a major success with a melee attack, a hail of arrows rains down on the target, causing piercing harm equal to your level.

children.name: Wounding Barrage
children.description: Your Ferocious Barrage also causes ongoing piercing harm until the target passes a passive save equal to your proficiency bonus.

children.name: Blinding Barrage
children.description: Your Ferocious Barrage also blinds the target for 1 round.

children.name: Exerted Barrage
children.description: Whenever your Ferocious Barrage triggers, you may expend 1 exertion to increase its harm by your level plus your proficiency bonus.

children.name: Ferocious Bash
children.description: Whenever you score a major success with a melee attack while holding a shield, you cause bludgeoning harm to the target equal to your armour.

children.name: Dazing Bash
children.description: If your Ferocious Bash triggers off of a critical hit, the target is also dazed for 1 round.

children.name: Exerted Bash
children.description: Whenever your Ferocious Bash triggers, you may expend 1 exertion to increase its harm by your armour plus your proficiency bonus.

children.name: Lethal Bash
children.description: Your Ferocious Bash's harm increases by an amount equal to your armour.

children.name: Ferocious Boost
children.description: 1/SR, when you score a major success with a melee attack, you can heal HP equal to double your level plus your proficiency bonus.

children.name: Exerted Boost
children.description: Whenever your Ferocious Boost triggers, you may expend 1 exertion to increase its healing by triple your level.

children.name: Extra Boost
children.description: You can use your Ferocious Boost twice between rests.

children.name: Medic's Boost
children.description: Whenever your Ferocious Boost triggers, you can choose for it to instead heal a creature of your choice within 60 feet of you.

children.name: Staminaborn
children.description: On attack critical success, recover 1 exertion.

children.name: Critical Focus
children.description: You have +1 attack critical success range.

children.name: Improved Critical Focus
children.description: Your critical damage bonus is increased by an amount equal to your level.

children.name: Echoing Precision
children.description: On attack critical success, you can repeat that attack against a different creature within reach or range. This repeat attack can score a maximum of a standard success.

children.name: Chaotic Conduit
children.description: On attack critical success, you gain a Chaos Charge until the end of combat. You may expend any number of Chaos Charges when making a damaging attack to add a number of d6s of damage to the attack equal to the number of Charges spent. Roll a d6 to determine the extra damage's type: 1. Piercing; 2. Slashing; 3. Poison; 4. Acid; 5. Necrotic; 6. Cold

children.name: Overgrowth
children.description: 1/SR, when you expend exertion, heal an amount of HP equal to double your level.

children.name: Hybrid Growth
children.description: Whenever you expend exertion, recover 1 spell slot level.

children.name: Potent Growth
children.description: Overgrowth's healing increases by double your level.

children.name: Arcane Growth
children.description: Overgrowth now also triggers whenever you expend a spell slot, and they operate on separate cooldowns.

children.name: Keen Flesh
children.description: 1/SR, on attack critical success, heal an amount of HP equal to double your level.

children.name: Scar Tissue
children.description: Whenever you are healed while bloodied, gain +1 resistance until your next rest.

children.name: Potent Flesh
children.description: Keen Flesh's healing increases by double your level.

children.name: Precision
children.description: Keen Flesh can also be triggered from an attack major success, which has a separate cooldown from the critical success triggering.

children.name: Weighted Strikes
children.description: Your attacks deal additional damage to creatures not standing on the ground equal to your level.

children.name: Superiority
children.description: Creatures not standing on the ground while adjacent to you deal less damage equal to your level plus your proficiency bonus if their reflex is lower than yours.

children.name: Superior Exposure
children.description: Creatures affected by Superior Dodge have -2 armour.

children.name: Superior Domination
children.description: Creatures affected by Superior Dodge deal less damage equal to quadruple the number of your allies within 10' of them.

children.name: Superior Suppression
children.description: Creatures affected by Superior Dodge are sluggish.

children.name: Considered Strikes
children.description: You deal additional damage to creatures not standing on the ground equal to your level plus your proficiency bonus if you are behind them in the initiative tracker.

children.name: Considered Defence
children.description: You gain resistance to the damage of creatures affected by Considered Strikes equal to your proficiency bonus.

children.name: Controlled Power
children.description: You deal additional damage to creatures affected by Considered Strikes and another child node of Weighted Strikes equal to double your level plus your proficiency bonus.

children.name: Controlled Defence
children.description: You gain resistance to the damage of creatures affected by Considered Strikes and another child node of Weighted Strikes equal to your level.

children.name: Challenging Strikes
children.description: You deal additional damage to healthy creatures not standing on the ground equal to your level plus your proficiency bonus.

children.name: Challenging Defence
children.description: You gain resistance to the damage of creatures affected by Challenging Strikes equal to your proficiency bonus.

children.name: Tactical Power
children.description: You deal additional damage to creatures affected by Challenging Strikes and another child node of Weighted Strikes equal to double your level plus your proficiency bonus.

children.name: Tactical Defence
children.description: You gain resistance to the damage of creatures affected by Challenging Strikes and another child node of Weighted Strikes equal to your level.

children.name: Sanguine Merriment
children.description: Whenever your party kills a creature suffering from ongoing harm, recover 2 exertion.

children.name: Merry Replenishment
children.description: 1/SR, when your party kills a creature suffering from ongoing harm, heal HP equal to quadruple your current exertion.

children.name: Finish Them Off
children.description: You deal additional damage to bloodied creatures equal to your level.

children.name: Potent Replenishment
children.description: Merry Replenishment's healing increases to 8 times your current exertion.

children.name: Extra Replenishment
children.description: Merry Replenishment can now be used twice between rests.

children.name: Constant Merriment
children.description: Whenever you hit a creature suffering from ongoing harm, recover 1 exertion.

children.name: Constant Replenishment
children.description: 1/SR, when you trigger Constant Merriment, heal HP equal to triple your current exertion.

children.name: Potent Merriment
children.description: Constant Merriment's exertion recovery increases to 2.

children.name: Start the Fun
children.description: Whenever you roll for initiative, you may cause ongoing acid harm equal to your level to a creature within 60' of you until it passes a passive save.

children.name: Carnival of Pain
children.description: Whenever a foe within 60' of you fails a passive save to end ongoing harm, gain 1 Pain Charge that lasts until the end of combat. Whenever you deal damage, all Pain Charges are expended to increase the damage by a number of d6s of acid damage equal to the number of charges spent.

children.name: Revelry in Pain
children.description: Whenever you expend Pain Charges, you also cause ongoing acid harm to the target equal to your proficiency bonus until it passes a passive save.

children.name: Slick Acrobatics
children.description: While you have at least 2 Pain Charges, all of your movement counts as shifting.

children.name: Exultant Pain
children.description: Whenever a foe within 60' of you fails a passive save to end ongoing harm, it immediately suffers acid harm equal to your level.

children.name: Toxic Skin
children.description: Once per long rest, as a Riverview action, you can coat your body in poison until your next rest. This requires your concentration. Whenever a creature adjacent to you hits you with a melee weapon attack during that time, it makes a save, becoming poisoned and suffering 1d6 ongoing poison harm on a fail, both until it passes a passive save.

children.name: Slippery Poison
children.description: While Toxic Skin is active, you cannot be grappled or restrained.

children.name: Extra Protections
children.description: Slippery Poison also prevents the blinded and sluggish conditions.

children.name: Spit Up
children.description: Whenever you would gain a condition that Slippery Poison prevents, you may choose a creature within 60' of you to immediately suffer poison harm equal to your level plus your proficiency bonus.

children.name: Ooze Logic
children.description: Whenever you would gain a condition that Slippery Poison prevents, you may immediately collapse into a puddle and shift up to 30', ignoring hostile creatures. In this puddle form, you can move through spaces as small as 6 inches wide.

children.name: Potent Toxins
children.description: Toxic Skin's ongoing harm increases to 3d6.

children.name: Venom Splash
children.description: Whenever Toxic Skin causes applies ongoing harm, you may apply 1d6 ongoing harm to another creature within 20' of the target.

children.name: Corrosion
children.description: Whenever a creature fails its passive save against Toxic Skin, it gets -1 AB for the remainder of combat.

children.name: Rattling Venom
children.description: While a creature is suffering Toxic Skin's ongoing harm, it is also rattled.

children.name: Miasmic Aura
children.description: While Toxic Skin is active, you radiate a 10' persistent zone that grants foes -1 AB. Additionally, whenever a creature attacks with this AB reduction, you gain 1 Miasma Charge (max 3) until Toxic Skin ends.

children.name: Miasma Reflux
children.description: As a Riverview action, you can expend a Miasma Charge to make a creature within 30' of you brittle for 1 round. If the creature is poisoned, it also suffers poison harm equal to your proficiency bonus.

children.name: Breathe Miasma
children.description: 1/SR, as a Riverview action, you can expend a Miasma Charge to gain temporary HP equal to double your level plus your proficiency bonus.

children.name: Miasma Vapour
children.description: As a Riverview action, you can expend a Miasma Charge to shapeshift into a Vapour Form for 1 round, gaining 20' of fly speed, converting all your movement to shifting, and gaining the ability to pass through the spaces of hostile creatures.

children.name: Stone Body
children.description: Your skin becomes stone, all gold costs from your journey activities are halved, you no longer need to breathe, you gain +4 maximum HP, your armour increases by 1, your reflex decreases by 1, and your unarmed attacks deal additional damage equal to your proficiency bonus.

children.name: Stone Bash
children.description: Your unarmed attacks deal additional damage equal to your level.

children.name: Boulder Body
children.description: You gain +10 maximum HP.

children.name: Heavy Hands
children.description: Your unarmed attacks have +1 AB.

children.name: Still as a Statue
children.description: 1/LR, as a Riverview action, you set all your speeds to 0 and become incapacitated. All attacks made against you in this form are reduced by 2 success tiers. You can end this effect at any time, but if it lasts for at least 24 hours, you emerge with full HP and no conditions or diseases.

children.name: Golem Grip
children.description: 1/combat, as a Riverview action, a creature within your reach becomes restrained until they use an action to break free. As a Riverview action while you are restraining a creature in this way, you can cause bludgeoning harm to them equal to your level plus your proficiency bonus.

children.name: Golem Stomp
children.description: 1/SR, as a Riverview action, you can cause thunder harm equal to your level plus your proficiency bonus to all foes adjacent to you. Each affected foe is then pushed 5' away from you or knocked prone (your choice for each).

children.name: Deep Reserves
children.description: You gain +10 maximum HP.

children.name: Structural Brace
children.description: The amount of weight you can hold increases to 45 tonnes and any contested Strength checks you make grant you a minimum roll of 18 on the d20.

children.name: Field of Stones
children.description: You can attempt to Hide in natural terrain regardless of light conditions, appearing as a natural rock formation, with a d6 expertise die. If the terrain is already rocky, your d20 roll on the Stealth check also has a minimum of 15.

children.name: Perfect Disguise
children.description: Your attempts to Hide in natural terrain always succeed.

children.name: Rolling Stone
children.description: 1/LR, as a Riverview action, you can shift up to 120', during which you can move through hostile spaces. The first time you enter a creature's space during this movement, it suffers bludgeoning harm equal to your proficiency bonus.

children.name: Earthshake
children.description: Once ever, as a Riverview action, you cause significant structural damage to any structures within 1km of you. All creatures in the area also suffer bludgeoning harm equal to your level.

children.name: Mass Revival
children.description: Once per long rest, as a Riverview action, you can instantly revive all allies on 0 HP within 60' of you. While this action is not on cooldown, it occupies your concentration.

children.name: Heal
children.description: 1/SR, as a Riverview action, you can heal a creature within 40' of you for an amount equal to double your level.

children.name: Frequent Heal
children.description: You can now use your Heal twice per short rest.

children.name: Robust Healing
children.description: Whenever you use a Riverview action on a child boon of Constitution (other than Mass Revival or its children), you gain outgoing healing for the remainder of combat equal to your proficiency bonus.

children.name: Inverted Heal
children.description: Heal now causes necrotic harm instead of healing, which is increased to quadruple your level.

children.name: Shield
children.description: 1/SR, as a Riverview action, grant a creature within 40' of you temporary HP equal to double your level plus your proficiency bonus.

children.name: Focusing Shield
children.description: Creatures affected by Shield cannot lose concentration against their will.

children.name: Potent Shield
children.description: Shield's temporary HP increases to five times your level.

children.name: Robust Shield
children.description: Whenever you use a Riverview action on a child boon of Constitution (other than Mass Revival or its children), you gain outgoing temporary HP for the remainder of combat equal to your level.

children.name: Dominate Mind
children.description: As a Riverview action, a creature within 20' of you must make a save, becoming dominated on a fail until it passes a passive save.

children.name: Reliable Domination
children.description: Creatures have -1 to their saves against Dominate Mind.

children.name: Distant Domination
children.description: Dominate Mind's range increases to 60'.

children.name: Persistant Domination
children.description: Dominate Mind now lasts for the remainder of combat.

children.name: A Solution for Anything
children.description: 1/SR, when a creature who can sense you starts their turn, you can grant it the ability to ignore all sources of disadvantage until its next turn.

children.name: Skill Focus
children.description: When you gain this boon, choose a skill you are proficient with to permanently gain an expertise die on.

children.name: True Expertise
children.description: Your expertise dice have a +1 bonus.

children.name: Skilled
children.description: When you gain this boon, gain proficiency in a skill of your choice.

children.name: Extra Focus
children.description: When you gain this boon, choose a skill you are proficient with, other than the skill chosen for Skill Focus, to permanently gain an expertise die on.

children.name: Ultimate Schema
children.description: Whenever you complete a long rest, choose the effect of a spell of 2nd level or lower. You can have that effect occur immediately, or keep it in reserve until your next long rest. While it is in reserve, you can cause it to occur at any point as a Riverview action.

children.name: Instant Schema
children.description: Whenever you trigger Ultimate Schema immediately, the spell effect is upcast two levels.

children.name: Frequent Schema
children.description: You can now use Ultimate Schema whenever you complete a short rest, and its reserve lasts until your next rest instead.

children.name: Smart Schema
children.description: Whenever you use a Riverview action on a child boon of Intellect (other than A Solution for Anything or its children), you gain bonus spell damage equal to your proficiency bonus for the remainder of combat.

children.name: Impromptu Persona
children.description: You can use your level in place of your Charisma for Deception and Persuasion checks.

children.name: Potent Persuasion
children.description: You gain an expertise die in Persuasion.

children.name: Potent Deception
children.description: You gain an expertise die in Deception.

children.name: Impromptu Flex
children.description: You can use your level in place of your Charisma or Strength for Intimidation and Brawn checks.

children.name: Transmogrify
children.description: During a long rest, you can perform a ritual to grant a creature of your choice ugly, troll-like features until your next long rest. To do so, the target must be on the same plane of existence as you, and you must have some of their DNA. While a creature has these features, they have a -4 penalty to all Persuasion and Deception checks.

children.name: Mocking Resemblance
children.description: Whenever you use Transmogrify, you may provide the DNA of a second creature. The target develops a grotesque parody of that creature's facial features, which is immediately recognised by creatures familiar with the second creature.

children.name: Unfortune Reputation
children.description: Whenever a creature familiar with the second creature from Mocking Resemblance sees the Transmogrified creature for the first time, it makes a save. On a fail, it believes the Transmogrified creature is the second creature for 1 minute.

children.name: Perfect Caricature
children.description: The Transmogrified creature gains advantage on Deception checks while impersonating the second creature from Mocking Resemblance.

children.name: Stolen Mannerisms
children.description: The Transmogrified creature unintentionally adopts the mimicked creature's speech patterns and habits, granting them the Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores of the mimicked creature.

children.name: Mutative Spillover
children.description: Whenever a Transmogrified creature scores a critical failure, it only scores critical failures on its d20 rolls until the Transmogrification ends.

children.name: Unstable Biology
children.description: Mutative Spillover now triggers on a critical failure or critical success.

children.name: Shared Mutation
children.description: Whenever Mutative Spillover first triggers, you may choose another creature within 30' of you to gain the same effect for the same duration.

children.name: Interesting Specimen
children.description: Whenever Mutative Spillover first triggers, you gain temporary HP equal to triple your level plus your proficiency bonus.

children.name: Trophy Collection
children.description: Whenever you obtain a creature's DNA for the first time, it gets recorded in your Trophy Collection. You gain an expertise die on History checks made to recall information about recorded creatures.

children.name: Borrowed Quirks
children.description: Whenever you complete a long rest, you may choose a creature from your Trophy Collection to gain one cosmetic trait from until your next long rest. Additionally, for the same duration, you gain advantage with a skill based on the chosen creature (DM's choice).

children.name: Catalogue of Horrors
children.description: Whenever you encounter a creature recorded in your Trophy Collection, you immediately know that it is already catalogued, even if it looks different than before. Additionally, the History bonus from Trophy Collection now applies to all creatures of the same species as a recorded creature.

children.name: Supreme Transmogrifier
children.description: Whenever you Transmogrify a creature, you can combine traits from up to 3 creatures in your Trophy Collection for the appearance instead of defaulting to troll-like features. Additionally, your attacks that frighten have advantage against Transmogrified creatures.

children.name: Pensive Reclusion
children.description: You deal additional damage equal to your level while no allies are within 10' of you.

children.name: Pensive Protection
children.description: This boon occupies your concentration. You and allies within 10' of you have +1 to all defences.

children.name: Distant Protection
children.description: Pensive Protection's range increases to 30'.

children.name: Potent Protection
children.description: Pensive Protection's defence bonus increases to +2.

children.name: Multitasked Protection
children.description: Pensive Protection no longer occupies your concentration.

children.name: Composure
children.description: You have 1 additional 1st-level spell slot.

children.name: Plentiful Composure
children.description: Composure grants 1 additional spell slot.

children.name: Potent Composure
children.description: Spell slots granted by Composure are 2nd level.

children.name: Fractured Composure
children.description: Whenever you expend a spell slot granted by Composure, roll a d6. On a 5+, that slot is not expended. On a 1, additionally expend your lowest-level spell slot.

children.name: Pensive Wrath
children.description: This boon occupies your concentration. You and allies within 10' of you have +1 critical hit range.

children.name: Controlled Wrath
children.description: Foes within your Pensive Wrath's area cannot score major or critical successes; such successes become standard successes instead.

children.name: Potent Wrath
children.description: Pensive Wrath's critical hit range bonus increases to +2.

children.name: Multitasked Wrath
children.description: Pensive Wrath no longer occupies your concentration.

children.name: All Existence is the Same
children.description: You can consider any creature to be of any creature type of your choice at will.

children.name: Madness
children.description: As a Riverview action, you can sacrifice HP equal to quadruple your level in order to gain ranged and area damage and resistance for the remainder of combat equal to your proficiency bonus.

children.name: Intense Madness
children.description: Madness' sacrifice requirement is doubled, but its bonus increases by your level plus your proficiency bonus.

children.name: Sturdy Madness
children.description: Madness no longer grants a damage bonus, but its bonus increases by your level plus your proficiency bonus.

children.name: Arcane Madness
children.description: Madness' sacrifice changes to requiring you to expend your lowest-level spell slot.

children.name: Antitoxins
children.description: As a Riverview action, cure all creatures of your choice within 30' of you of the poisoned or weakened conditions. Then, a cured creature's spells cost -1 slot level (minimum 1) for the remainder of combat.

children.name: Protoxins
children.description: Antitoxin can now grant either of its conditions to a specific target instead of curing it (you choose for each target), but the target must fail a save for the effect to take hold.

children.name: Mutual Invigoration
children.description: Whenever you cure a creature with Antitoxin, you also gain its lasting benefits.

children.name: Martial Invigoration
children.description: Antitoxin's lasting benefit also grants -1 exertion cost of maneuvers (minimum 1).

children.name: Look Out
children.description: As a Riverview action, you grant all creatures of your choice within 30' of you immunity to the effects of the unconscious and incapacitated conditions for the remainder of combat. This allows creatures to act while at 0 HP.

children.name: Extra Alert
children.description: Look Out also grants immunity to the confused and dazed conditions.

children.name: Snap Out of It
children.description: Look Out also grants immunity to the frightened and rattled conditions.

children.name: Anticipation
children.description: Whenever you use a Riverview action on a child boon of Understanding (other than All Existence is the Same or its children), you gain a bonus to the percentage of health restored when you revive a creature for the remainder of combat equal to your proficiency bonus.

children.name: Orbit
children.description: Whenever you roll for initiative, an orb of static electricity begins to orbit you at an unpredictable distance. Roll a d6, and for the remainder of combat you project a persistent zone that always, and only, covers the spaces that are a number of spaces away from you equal to the roll. This persistent zone causes lightning harm to foes equal to half your proficiency bonus.

children.name: Slow and Tough
children.description: Your Speed is reduced by 5', but you gain +12 maximum HP.

children.name: Extra Tough
children.description: You gain resistance equal to half your proficiency bonus.

children.name: Potent Toughness
children.description: You gain +12 maximum HP.

children.name: Impotent
children.description: Slow and Tough's Speed reduction changes to reducing your damage by 1.

children.name: Wormhole
children.description: Whenever you roll for initiative, a portal opens on the ground in a space adjacent to you, as well as one adjacent to a hostile creature within 60' of you. Whenever a creature steps onto either portal, you may have it instantly teleport to the other.

children.name: Controlled Wormhole
children.description: Wormhole no longer triggers on initiative roll, but instead now can be used as a Riverview action.

children.name: Secure Wormhole
children.description: Wormhole's portal near a hostile creature can now be up to 15' away from the creature.

children.name: Remote Wormhole
children.description: Wormhole's portal near you can now be up to 15' away from you.

children.name: Danger Zone
children.description: Whenever you score an area major hit, the target is debilitated for 1 round.

children.name: Blast Zone
children.description: Whenever Danger Zone triggers, the target is pushed 10' away from you

children.name: Reliable Danger
children.description: Danger Zone now triggers on hit, instead of major hit.

children.name: Cluster Zone
children.description: Whenever Danger Zone triggers, all creatures of your choice adjacent to the target also suffer the same effects.

children.name: Empathic Prediction
children.description: Whenever a creature makes an attack against you that you have observed before (whether from that creature or another), you can use your reaction to replace your relevant defence with your Insight bonus for that attack.

children.name: Gather Information
children.description: You gain an expertise die in Investigation.

children.name: Recognise Motive
children.description: You gain an expertise die in Insight.

children.name: Expert Gathering
children.description: Gather Information's expertise die increases to a d6.

children.name: Unrelated Clues
children.description: Whenever you spend at least 1 minute investigating an object, creature, or location, you may gain a Clue for that thing until your next long rest. You may expend a Clue charge after making an ability check directly related to its topic to add a d4 to the check's result.

children.name: Borrowed Feelings
children.description: Whenever a creature within 60' of you becomes charmed or frightened, you gain +1 AB against that creature for the remainder of combat.

children.name: Emotional Feedback
children.description: Whenever a creature you have Borrowed Feelings against hits you, it suffers acid harm equal to your level.

children.name: Second-hand Courage
children.description: While Borrowed Feelings is active, you are immune to the charmed and frightened conditions.

children.name: Contagious Mood
children.description: Whenever Borrowed Feelings triggers, you may choose another creature within 30' of you to gain the same condition for the same duration.

children.name: Predictable Patterns
children.description: Whenever you see a creature make an attack roll, you can set aside a Prediction die (d4) if you don't already have one. Whenever that creature makes another attack, after you hear its result, you can choose to roll your Prediction die, expending it and either adding or subtracting the result from the attack roll.

children.name: Seen This Before
children.description: Whenever you roll Predictable Patterns' Prediction die for the exact same attack that granted you the die in the first place, it becomes a d6.

children.name: Fate's Rehearsal
children.description: Whenever you expend Predictable Patterns' Prediction die, you learn the target's maximum HP.

children.name: Painfully Obvious
children.description: Whenever Predictable Patterns causes a creature to fail to hit with its attack roll when it otherwise would have succeeded, the next attack made against the target gains a bonus to damage equal to your level.

children.name: Supple Face
children.description: Whenever you complete a long rest, you can change your physical characteristics from your neck up until the end of your next long rest. You can make any changes you desire, so long as your features still resemble a humanoid's.

children.name: Man Behind the Face
children.description: Whenever you change your physical characteristics with Supple Face, you gain 1 affix with a maximum point value of -10 and another affix with a minimum point value of 10. This lasts until the changes revert.

children.name: Influence Personality
children.description: You can choose the Affinity for each affix granted to you by Man Behind the Face.

children.name: Versatile Personality
children.description: You roll each affix granted to you by Man Behind the Face with advantage.

children.name: Mitigated Impact
children.description: The first affix granted to you by Man Behind the Face instead has a maximum point value of -5, and the second has a minimum point value of 7.

children.name: Blackout
children.description: Whenever you finish a long rest after a waking period during which you gained experience and had your physical characteristics modified by Supple Face, you awaken with 1 additional fatigue which lasts until you take a long rest. Additionally, roll a d6 to determine what you find in your pocket: 1. someone else's blood (you gain an additional level of fatigue or strife until long rest, chosen randomly); 2. missing coins (lose 2d20 gold); 3. a Very Clean Tooth (no effect); 4. extra coins (gain 2d20 gold); 5. unexpected treasures (gain a random loot result that you are not specialised in); 6. note in someone else's handwriting (ask the DM a yes/no question, it has an 80% chance of being true)

children.name: Influence Mystery
children.description: You make your Blackout roll with advantage.

children.name: Embrace Fugue
children.description: Each roll result of Blackout is improved: 1. Your party gains 1 experience; 2. The gold lost becomes 2d12; 3. You gain +1 to tooth-related d20 rolls for each Very Clean Tooth in your posession; 4. The gold gained becomes 4d12; 5. The loot is green; 6. The answer has a 95% chance to be true.

children.name: Lingering Mania
children.description: Each roll result of Blackout grants you an additional bonus until your next long rest: 1. You have +1 AB; 2. You gain resistance equal to your proficiency bonus; 3. Your bite deals additional damage equal to your proficiency bonus; 4. You gain gold find equal to your level; 5. Whenever you find an enchanted item, it has a 50% chance to become a loot roll instead; 6. You have +1 to all ability checks.

children.name: Thousandfold Visage
children.description: Whenever you change your physical characteristics with Supple Face, you may choose to manifest an additional illusory overlay that projects a semi-transparent mask onto your face which flickers through dozens of expressions and emotional states. The overlay is visible to all creatures within 10' of you and lasts until your next long rest. Whenever your party makes a Group Persuasion check against a creature who can see the overlay, it has an 80% chance to gain a +3 bonus and a 20% chance to gain a -3 bonus.

children.name: Echoes of Another
children.description: Once per long rest, you can ask your Thousandfold Visage a question about a creature in your line of sight by rolling a d6 and receiving its answer in your own voice: 1-2. The Visage mutters nonsense; 3-4. You learn the creature's current emotional state; 5. You learn the creature's Charisma score; 6. You learn whether or not the creature has lied in the past minute.

children.name: Mask of Many Hungers
children.description: Whenever you activate your Thousandfold Visage, choose one Hunger for it to have: Attention, Fear, or Admiration. Whenever you or your party in a group check makes a Charisma check that aligns with the Hunger against a creature who can see the overlay, the check gains a +2 bonus.

children.name: Borrowed Faces
children.description: After interacting with a creature for 10+ minutes, you can record its face. Whenever you activate your Thousandfold Visage, you can choose its shifting overlay to appear as one of your recorded faces. Once per long rest, you or your party in a group check can make a Charisma check with advantage against a creature who knows the overlayed face, due to their subtle confusion.

children.name: Ooze Familiar
children.description: This boon occupies your concentration. You emit a 5' persistent zone around you that causes minion acid harm to foes equal to your level.

children.name: Spreading Slime
children.description: Your melee attacks against creatures within your Ooze Familiar's zone splash an amount of damage equal to your bonus minion damage.

children.name: Potent Slime
children.description: Your Spreading Slime splashes additional damage equal to your level.

children.name: Distant Spread
children.description: Your Spreading Slime's splash radius increases to 10'.

children.name: Slime Shots
children.description: Your Spreading Slime no longer requires your attack's target to be within your Ooze Familiar's zone, and can trigger off of any non-area attack, but its base splash amount is now equal to half your bonus minion damage.

children.name: Extra Ooze
children.description: Your Ooze Familiar's zone radius increases by 5' and its harm is increased by an amount equal to your proficiency bonus.

children.name: Massive Ooze
children.description: Your Ooze Familiar's zone radius increases by 10'.

children.name: Potent Ooze
children.description: Your Ooze Familiar's harm increases by an amount equal to your level.

children.name: Jumping Ooze
children.description: Whenever you roll for initiative, you choose which member of your party your Ooze Familiar attaches to.

children.name: Unexpected Ally
children.description: If you have no bonus minion damage, Ooze Familiar's harm is increased by an amount equal to your level.

children.name: Potent Ally
children.description: Unexpected Ally's harm bonus increases to double your level.

children.name: Massive Ally
children.description: If you have no bonus minion damage, Ooze Familiar's zone radius increases by 10'.

children.name: Doubted Ally
children.description: Unexpected Ally still applies so long as your bonus minion damage is less than your level.

children.name: Likeability
children.description: You can define an important contact that you have who is in an influential position, such as a minor celebrity, a police captain, or the editor of a newspaper.
